name: StyleSeed
hook: 960 stars. An open-source design-method engine for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor: 23 agent skills enforce 74 fixed design rules across layout, color, typography, spacing, and component patterns — then run a 0-100 quality-gate score that requires revision before any UI is presented. Addresses the 'AI-generated UIs look generic' problem with repeatable expert judgment. v2.5.0 strengthened the quality rules.

name: design-judge-skills
hook: 1,000 stars. Evidence-driven agent skills for the full design award pipeline: case retrieval, design evaluation, award matching (iF DESIGN, Red Dot, IDEA, K-Design, GOOD DESIGN Japan), entry writing, and submission compliance checking. Backed by 22,125 aggregated observations from award-winning or shortlisted works. K-Design 2026 testing on July 3 showed 40.87% accuracy on top-115 award predictions. Apache 2.0, 155 forks.

name: Open Design
hook: 96.7K+ stars, still the top DESIGN item in the ecosystem. Open-source alternative to Claude Design: 151 brand-grade DESIGN.md packages, local-first desktop app routing design tasks to 25+ coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more). Exports real HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4. Hit #1 on GitTrend and crossed 40k stars within two weeks of launch. Entered digest Sept 17.

name: diagram-design

name: Caveman
hook: 106.5K+ stars — the undisputed #1 COST tool in the ecosystem. The 'talk like caveman' skill + proxy cuts output tokens 65% and input 33%. Adobe Research documented 1.4–2.4× cost reduction; JetBrains measured 8.5% fewer output tokens with no quality loss. v2.7.0 supports 30+ agents. If you run Claude Code on a Pro plan, Caveman is still the single highest-ROI install.

name: RTK — Rust Token Killer
hook: 80.8K+ stars. Single Rust binary CLI proxy that silently compresses shell-command output before it reaches your LLM — 60–90% reduction on git, npm, cargo, docker, and 100+ other common dev commands. Zero dependencies, cross-platform, works with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and 11+ others. The COST companion to Caveman: Caveman handles prose tokens; RTK handles tool output.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 4 — 80.8K+ stars, still the top tool-output compression choice

name: OpenSkills
hook: 10.8K stars. Universal skills loader: brings Anthropic's SKILL.md format to every AI coding agent — Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Aider, Codex, and anything that can read AGENTS.md. Discovers, installs, and manages skills from GitHub repos; supports dual-loading from `.agent/skills`, `.claude/skills`, and `~/.openskills`. The bridge for teams that don't run Claude Code exclusively but still want Claude's skill ecosystem.

name: Understand Anything
hook: 83K+ stars. A five-agent pipeline scans your codebase and builds an interactive knowledge graph — color-coded by architectural layer, searchable, every node shows code and a plain-English explanation. Charlie Automates called it 'GitHub's #1 repo of the day' in a dedicated deep-dive post. First appeared Sept 17; still accumulating stars.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 4 — 83K+ stars; Charlie Automates blog coverage

name: Graphify
hook: 119K+ stars — one of the fastest-growing Claude Code tools since July. Turns any codebase into a queryable knowledge graph via deterministic AST parsing. No LLM, no vector store, fully offline. MIT licensed, 36 languages, a /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Has grown from ~90K stars in July.

name: text-to-cad
hook: 16.2K stars. A library of agent skills for CAD, CAE, and CAM workflows: generate and edit STEP, STL, 3MF, and GLB models; produce robot description files (URDF, SRDF, SDF); slice to G-code; run 3D-printability checks; and hand off to SendCutSend or Bambu Labs printers — all from a natural-language prompt inside Claude Code or Codex. The first production-ready CAD skill bundle in the ecosystem.

name: brag
hook: 6K stars. One command turns any project into a shareable launch video: voiceover, motion graphics, and marketing copy, all output to a `brag-output/` folder. Powered by Hyperframes under the hood. Install as a Claude Code plugin and run `/brag` at the end of any build session. From the Latent Space community; targets devs who ship without a marketing team.

name: JARVIS (ethanplus.ai)
hook: 779 stars. macOS voice assistant for Claude Code: talk to your Mac and JARVIS brainstorms your project with you, writes a design spec, kicks off a Claude Code build, and tells you out loud when the session needs human input. name: Statewright
hook: 491 stars. Define AI agent workflows as state machines — planning states get read-only tools, implementation unlocks edit access, testing permits only designated commands. Enforced at the protocol layer via MCP, not prompt gymnastics. Plugin 0.3.3 (this week) improved native MCP read-only annotations and session management. Works across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and Pi. Rust engine, Apache 2.0.
